alerts.title: Voice Mailboxes Down
alerts.description: Voice mailboxes are down throughout the park, and we cannot receive new voice messages. The issue is being worked on. In the meantime, please email the park for assistance and information at care_information@nps.gov.

alerts.title: Visitor Center Holiday Hours and Closures
alerts.description: The Capitol Reef visitor center will have shortened hours or be closed for the following holidays: November 25 closing at 1 pm. November 26, closed. December 24 and 25, closed. December 31 closing at 1 pm. January 1, closed.

alerts.title: Special Event: September 19 and 25, 2027 Scenic Drive temporary closure
alerts.description: Reef Ride Bike Days: For this special event the Scenic Drive will be open to bicycles and pedestrians only for part of the day on Saturday, September 18 and Saturday, September 25, 2027. The road will be closed to vehicles from sunrise to 3pm to allow for bicycles and pedestrians to enjoy the road at a more leisurely pace. The Fruita area and main road through the park (UT highway 24) - will remain open and unaffected by this closure.

alerts.title: Monsoon Season & Flash Floods
alerts.description: Heavy rains can cause sudden flooding, especially in canyons and washes. Do not drive or hike through flood waters. Get to high ground and wait for floods to subside. Some roads may close temporarily; closures are posted at the visitor center.

alerts.title: Elevated E. Coli levels - Fremont River and Sulphur Creek
alerts.description: Recent water quality testing shows elevated E. coli levels in the Fremont River and Sulphur Creek. A warning advisory has been issued by the Utah DEQ. Use caution if entering the water. Do not get water in your mouth, do not swim. Wash hands with soap and water.
